description: This file defines a custom exception class HookNotFoundException used within the Fineract project to handle cases where a hook with a specific name or identifier is not found. It extends the AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException and provides constructors for different scenarios.
external_methods: super(String errorCode, String defaultUserMessage, Object... args)
super(String errorCode, String defaultUserMessage, Object arg, Throwable cause)

classes.name: HookNotFoundException
classes.description: A specific exception indicating that a hook was not found, either by name or identifier, used for error handling within the Fineract infrastructure.

methods.name: HookNotFoundException(String name)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a message indicating that a hook with the specified name does not exist.

methods.name: HookNotFoundException(Long hookId)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a message indicating that a hook with the specified identifier does not exist.

methods.name: HookNotFoundException(Long hookId, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a message and a cause from an underlying data access exception, indicating that a hook with the specified identifier was not found.
